mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job (name, skill_id, question_template, output_path, enabled, schedule_rules, created_by, metric_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{skillId}, #{questionTemplate}, #{outputPath}, #{enabled}, #{scheduleRules}, #{createdBy}, #{metricId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.name = #{name}
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job SET name=#{name}, skill_id=#{skillId}, question_template=#{questionTemplate}, output_path=#{outputPath}, enabled=#{enabled}, schedule_rules=#{scheduleRules}, metric_id=#{metricId}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job j LEFT JOIN skill_dependency_metric m ON m.id = j.metric_id LEFT JOIN skill_manage s ON s.id = j.skill_id WHERE j.metric_id = #{metricId} AND j.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY j.created_at DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_job_execution (job_id, trigger_type, status, conversation_id, resolved_output_path, report_markdown, md_file_written, md_file_exists, error_msg, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{conversationId}, #{resolvedOutputPath}, #{reportMarkdown}, #{mdFileWritten}, #{mdFileExists}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status=#{status}, conversation_id=#{conversationId}, resolved_output_path=#{resolvedOutputPath}, report_markdown=COALESCE(#{reportMarkdown}, report_markdown), md_file_written=#{mdFileWritten}, md_file_exists=#{mdFileExists}, error_msg=#{errorMsg}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE skill_job_execution SET trigger_type=#{triggerType}, status=#{status}, conversation_id=NULL, resolved_output_path=NULL, md_file_written=FALSE, md_file_exists=FALSE, error_msg=NULL, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_job_execution WHERE ( status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING') OR (status = 'FAILED' AND error_msg LIKE '应用重启中断%') ) AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE + 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_job_execution SET status = 'PENDING', error_msg = '应用重启中断，已恢复排队', completed_at = NULL WHERE ( status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING') OR (status = 'FAILED' AND error_msg LIKE '应用重启中断%') ) AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND created_at < CURRENT_DATE + 1
